name: yank
description: Copy anything from a Claude Code conversation in two keys: a block, a reply, a prompt, a range of turns, the commands Claude ran or the whole transcript.

look.title: Block look
look.description: card: each block Claude wrote for you in a frame captioned with its key. quiet: the caption alone, no frame. off: blocks drawn as Claude Code draws them.

border.title: Frame border
border.description: The line a card is drawn with.

frameColor.title: Frame color
frameColor.description: A Claude Code theme key (subtle, inactive, promptBorder, suggestion, claude, …) so it follows your theme, or a #rrggbb color.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: The color of block keys and range words: a theme key (suggestion, claude, permission, …) or a #rrggbb color.

paneBackground.title: Palette background
paneBackground.description: What the palette pane paints behind itself: transparent shows your terminal's own background; or a theme key or hex color.

ids.title: Number prompts
ids.description: Show each prompt's turn number, faint, at its right edge: what o3, x2-4 and the palette's #n refer to.

autoCopy.title: Copy automatically
autoCopy.description: off: never touch the clipboard unasked. single: when a reply has exactly one block, it is on your clipboard as Claude finishes. all: every block of the reply, each its own clipboard-history entry.

band.title: Blocks above the prompt
band.description: Keep the latest reply's blocks in a row above the prompt; a bare digit in an empty prompt copies one.

confirm.title: Say what was copied
confirm.description: A short toast after each copy.

guide.title: Teach Claude to fence what you copy
guide.description: Add a short note to Claude's system prompt: every command, snippet or message for you goes in its own titled block.

keys.title: Palette keys
keys.description: Remap any of: reply prompt both blocks commands all range prev next, as action=letter pairs, e.g. "prev=k next=j". Each action needs its own letter after the remap, or all keys stay default; digits stay the blocks'.
keys.default: reply=o prompt=p both=x blocks=b commands=c all=t range=r prev=h next=l

speakers.title: Names in copied exchanges
speakers.description: How a copied exchange or transcript names the two sides, as <your name>|<Claude's name>.

stackGapMs.title: Gap between stacked copies (ms)
stackGapMs.description: When several items are copied, the pause between them so a clipboard manager records each one. 0 copies them back to back.
